_notes: Map types (like AoE map scripts). 'defaults' holds every generation setting; each type lists only the settings it changes. Settings: noise_frequency (higher = smaller, more broken-up features); ocean_fraction (share of ALL tiles that is sea; ocean touching land becomes coast); edge_ocean_width/strength (how strongly seas hug the map edges; 0 strength = seas anywhere); lake_/mountain_/hills_/swamp_/forest_fraction (shares of the LAND tiles); plains_fraction_of_rest (driest share of the remaining open land); river_sources (extra rivers from hills/mountains; every lake also gets one). Types needing more than parameters (e.g. scripted layouts) can add a 'script' key later and branch in map_generator.gd.
